top_signals.title: BOJ holds rates at 1%, warns of underlying inflation exceeding 2% target
top_signals.summary: The decision comes as speculation continues to swirl around whether the Bank of Japan will hike rates at a faster pace.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: AI boomtowns worsen divide in China’s split-screen economy
top_signals.summary: In Hefei, the heart of China’s memory-chip industry, factories can barely keep up with the world’s appetite for AI hardware. In Changchun, the rust-belt home of gasoline-powered carmaking, officials admitted to "unprecedented” difficulties — a phrase later removed after drawing social media attention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ECB to start implementing enhanced repo facility for central banks
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The arms race for cheaper anti-ballistic weapons is underway
top_signals.summary: After years of a Patriot monopoly, new anti-ballistic alternatives are emerging. Officials hope to see some of them on the battlefield by the end of 2026.
